authority: Operator decision taken at the ticket 7 authorisation review (plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 7, Authorisation packet). Durable recording per CLAUDE.md §9.4; status assignment per §12.2; no fabricated project facts per §13.3; declarations per the working_assumptions convention.
why: The ticket 7 packet named AgroVIR's hosting capacity for the M25-M30 non-academic placement as the largest single content gap the placement decision opened. The placement is evaluated, so Part B-1 must show that AgroVIR can host a researcher, and no Tier 3 record showed it. The operator answered against the packet rather than against the input pack, so these records cite this entry and not an input pack item.

source_of_the_answers.what: The operator's answers of 2026-08-12, supplied in session at the authorisation review.
source_of_the_answers.why_not_the_input_pack: plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md and its in-tier copy are byte-identical on disk (183,385 bytes, empty diff) and contain no answer to the placement-hosting question: the string 'Maróti' does not occur, and the item 12 lines at 2300 and 2685 hold the question, not an answer. Operator revisions delivered as files outside the repository are not repository state. These answers therefore enter Tier 3 citing this decision-log record, which is inside Tier 4 and durable.

the_four_counts: Input pack item 12 sets out what Part B-1 must show: who supervises the fellow on site and with what seniority, what workspace and system access she gets, what she does for six months, and what she gains that ELTE cannot give her. Two counts are answered, one is derived from them, and one stays Unresolved.

decisions.why_assumed: Operator-supplied and not independently verified. The company website names no staff, as with the Balázs contact. A name with no verifiable source behind it is an assumption the operator owns, not a fact the repository can evidence, so it is declared rather than Confirmed.
decisions.open: His title and seniority inside AgroVIR are Unresolved. Part B-2 §5 needs the role, and the Part B-1 placement argument leans on the seniority: an evaluator reads 'supervised by a named person' differently from 'supervised by the head of engineering'.

decisions.supplied_answer: field trials with farmers via the AgroVIR network
decisions.why_not_adopted: It answers a different question. Field access is what AgroVIR already provides as VALIDATION_PARTNER from M16, independently of the placement, and WP5 tasks T5.4 and T5.5 already depend on it. It would be true had the placement never been decided, so it evidences nothing about hosting capacity. A non-academic placement is about embedding the fellow in the organisation, not about access to its customers' fields.
decisions.recorded_instead_as: consortium/capabilities.json hosting_capacity_for_the_placement.supplementary_field_access, status Confirmed, with the distinction stated on the record.
missing_fields: Desk or office location during M25-M30
Access to the FMIS development or staging environment
decisions.note: This is the one count of four with nothing behind it, and it is the count an evaluator tests the placement's reality against. Only AgroVIR can supply it. Nothing is guessed (§13.3).

decisions.action: Reframed by the operator, not replaced.
why_reframed: An MSCA placement must serve the fellow's training, not the host company's engineering.
The draft itself calls the MVP 'the research-to-operation demonstrator, not the primary scientific objective' (§1.2 ¶158).
§2.2 records the DrR components as the fellow's background IP, so six months developing her own prototype inside a commercial partner raises an ownership question the proposal has not addressed.
value: Operational hardening of the prediction pipeline in a production FMIS environment
The nine-dimension operational assessment, producing D5.4
The FMIS integration roadmap written from inside the implementing company, producing D5.5
Requirements engineering and user testing with commercial growers
decisions.why_confirmed: An operator decision recorded in this entry, on the same footing as the item 6 Career Development Plan deliverable and the 30-month duration. It is not a draft fact and does not claim to be.
decisions.consistency_with_the_work_plan: The four items map onto WP5 content the draft already carries: T5.4 and T5.6 to the operational assessment and D5.4, and T5.7 to the roadmap and D5.5. The placement deepens existing WP5 content rather than adding a strand, which is why no task or deliverable is invented here.
decisions.open: The background-IP question stays open. It is a §2.2 drafting matter, not a Tier 3 fact, and it is listed in the authorisation packet.

decisions.check: D5.1, the DrR web MVP, must land before M25 so that M25-M30 is validation and transfer rather than first build.
decisions.finding: Already satisfied by the seeded state. MS5 at M23 requires the web MVP to be externally evaluated under farmer conditions (§3.1 ¶317), which cannot happen before D5.1 exists, so the MVP precedes the placement window by construction.
decisions.carried_forward: Phase 4 owns deliverable due months and must not schedule D5.1 into M25-M30.

decisions.count: What the placement gives that ELTE cannot
decisions.value: A production FMIS environment, a commercial engineering practice, and direct contact with paying growers.
decisions.derivation: Derived from the AR-3 work-content items against the ELTE participant_capacity record. ELTE is the methodological and training environment and its §3.2 capacity is research infrastructure, so it supplies none of the three. The draft states no comparison of the two environments, which is why this is Inferred and not a lift.

status_after.hosting_capacity_for_the_placement: Unresolved overall, on the workspace count alone. Was a single null field with all four counts missing.
status_after.agrovir_key_people: Assumed. Was Unresolved. Two names, both declared, both titles Unresolved.
status_after.part_b2_capacity_detail: Unresolved. Four operator-deferred fields remain, down from five.

what_this_record_does_not_do: It does not authorise the run. Authorisation is a separate operator act with its own record, and selected_call.json action_confirmation_ref stays null until it happens.
